name: Flamsteadbury Lane Play Area
description: Fenced play area between Flamsteadbury Lane and Stephens Way, with a baby and toddler zone (baby swings, climbing frame with slide, rockers, springer, spinners) and a junior zone (three-tower play structure with fireman's pole and climbing wall, net spinner, swings). Outdoor gym and a grassy area with a goal outside.
